title: सप्तषष्टितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Duhshanta asks Shakuntala to be his wife by the Gandharva rite, and she agrees on condition that her son be heir to his throne. They marry, the king departs promising to send for her, and Kanva on his return blesses the union.
summary.kn: ಗಾಂಧರ್ವ ವಿಧಿಯಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಪತ್ನಿಯಾಗೆಂದು ದುಷ್ಯಂತನು ಶಕುಂತಲೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ತನ್ನ ಮಗನು ಯುವರಾಜನಾಗಬೇಕೆಂಬ ಷರತ್ತಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅವಳು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ವಿವಾಹದ ನಂತರ ಕರೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವೆನೆಂದು ಮಾತುಕೊಟ್ಟು ರಾಜನು ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮರಳಿದ ಕಣ್ವರು ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಆಶೀರ್ವದಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: दुःषन्त शकुन्तला से गान्धर्व विधि से पत्नी बनने को कहते हैं, और वे इस शर्त पर मानती हैं कि उनका पुत्र युवराज होगा। विवाह के बाद राजा उन्हें बुलवाने का वचन देकर चले जाते हैं, और लौटकर कण्व इस सम्बन्ध को आशीर्वाद देते हैं।
summary.te: గాంధర్వ విధిలో తన భార్య కమ్మని దుష్యంతుడు శకుంతలను అడుగుతాడు; తన కుమారుడు యువరాజు కావాలనే షరతుతో ఆమె అంగీకరిస్తుంది. వివాహం తర్వాత పిలిపించుకుంటానని మాట ఇచ్చి రాజు వెళ్తాడు; తిరిగివచ్చిన కణ్వుడు ఆ సంబంధాన్ని ఆశీర్వదిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: காந்தர்வ முறையில் தன் மனைவியாகுமாறு துஷ்யந்தன் ஶகுந்தலையைக் கேட்க, தன் மகன் இளவரசனாக வேண்டும் என்ற நிபந்தனையுடன் அவள் ஒப்புகிறாள். மணத்துக்குப் பின் அழைத்துக்கொள்வதாக வாக்களித்து மன்னன் புறப்பட, திரும்பிய கண்வர் அந்த உறவை ஆசீர்வதிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ഗാന്ധർവ വിവാഹത്തിലൂടെ തന്നെ ഭാര്യയാക്കണമെന്ന് ദുഷ്യന്തൻ ശകുന്തളയോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; തന്റെ പുത്രൻ രാജസിംഹാസനത്തിന് അവകാശിയാകണമെന്ന വ്യവസ്ഥയിൽ അവൾ സമ്മതിക്കുന്നു. അവർ വിവാഹിതരാകുന്നു; തന്നെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോകാൻ ആളയയ്ക്കാമെന്ന് വാക്കുനൽകി രാജാവ് മടങ്ങുന്നു; മടങ്ങിവരുന്ന കണ്വൻ ആ ബന്ധത്തെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.67; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: दुःषन्त उवाच

meaning.en: Dushyanta said:

verses.text:
सुव्यक्तं राजपुत्री त्वं यथा कल्याणि भाषसे ।
भार्या मे भव सुश्रोणि ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते ॥

meaning.en: Princess, what you say makes it quite plain who you are. Be my wife, fair-hipped lady, and tell me what I can do for you.

verses.text:
सुवर्णमाला वासांसि कुण्डले परिहाटके ।
नानापत्तनजे शुभ्रे मणिरत्ने च शोभने ॥

meaning.en: Today I will bring you golden garlands, clothes, a pair of earrings of fine gold, bright jewels and gems from many cities, gold coins and deerskins.

verses.text:
आहरामि तवाद्याहं निष्कादीन्यजिनानि च ।
सर्वं राज्यं तवाद्यास्तु भार्या मे भव शोभने ॥

meaning.en: Let my whole kingdom be yours today. Be my wife, lovely one.

verses.text:
गान्धर्वेण च मां भीरु विवाहेनैहि सुन्दरि ।
विवाहानां हि रम्भोरु गान्धर्वः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Come to me by a Gandharva marriage, timid beauty; of all marriages, fair-thighed one, the Gandharva is called the best.

verses.text: शकुन्तलोवाच

meaning.en: Shakuntala said:

verses.text:
फलाहारो गतो राजन्पिता मे इत आश्रमात् ।
तं मुहूर्तं प्रतीक्षस्व स मां तुभ्यं प्रदास्यति ॥

meaning.en: King, my father has gone from the hermitage to gather fruit. Wait a short while; he will give me to you.

verses.text: दुःषन्त उवाच

meaning.en: Dushyanta said:

verses.text:
इच्छामि त्वां वरारोहे भजमानामनिन्दिते ।
त्वदर्थं मां स्थितं विद्धि त्वद्गतं हि मनो मम ॥

meaning.en: I want you, faultless lady, and you are devoted to me. Know that I stand here for your sake, for my mind has gone to you.

verses.text:
आत्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव गतिरात्मैव चात्मनः ।
आत्मनैवात्मनो दानं कर्तुमर्हसि धर्मतः ॥

meaning.en: A person is his own kinsman, his own refuge; by dharma you may yourself give yourself away.

verses.text:
अष्टावेव समासेन विवाहा धर्मतः स्मृताः ।
ब्राह्मो दैवस्तथैवार्षः प्राजापत्यस्तथासुरः ॥

meaning.en: In brief, dharma recognises just eight kinds of marriage: Brahma, Daiva, Arsha, Prajapatya, Asura,

verses.text:
गान्धर्वो राक्षसश्चैव पैशाचश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः ।
तेषां धर्मान्यथापूर्वं मनुः स्वायंभुवोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Gandharva, Rakshasa, and the eighth, Paishacha. Svayambhuva Manu declared the rules of these in due order.

verses.text:
प्रशस्तांश्चतुरः पूर्वान्ब्राह्मणस्योपधारय ।
षडानुपूर्व्या क्षत्रस्य विद्धि धर्म्याननिन्दिते ॥

meaning.en: Know that the first four are praised for a Brahmin, and that for a Kshatriya, blameless lady, six are lawful in sequence.

verses.text:
राज्ञां तु राक्षसोऽप्युक्तो विट्शूद्रेष्वासुरः स्मृतः ।
पञ्चानां तु त्रयो धर्म्या द्वावधर्म्यौ स्मृताविह ॥

meaning.en: For kings even the Rakshasa form is allowed, and the Asura form is allowed among Vaishyas and Shudras. Of the five, three are lawful and two unlawful.

verses.text:
पैशाचश्चासुरश्चैव न कर्तव्यौ कथंचन ।
अनेन विधिना कार्यो धर्मस्यैषा गतिः स्मृता ॥

meaning.en: The Paishacha and Asura forms must never be practised. This is the proper rule, and such is the course of dharma.

verses.text:
गान्धर्वराक्षसौ क्षत्रे धर्म्यौ तौ मा विशङ्किथाः ।
पृथग्वा यदि वा मिश्रौ कर्तव्यौ नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: The Gandharva and Rakshasa forms are lawful for a Kshatriya; do not doubt it. They may be used separately or combined, without question.

verses.text:
सा त्वं मम सकामस्य सकामा वरवर्णिनि ।
गान्धर्वेण विवाहेन भार्या भवितुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: You are as full of desire for me as I am for you, fair lady; by a Gandharva marriage you are fit to become my wife.

verses.text: शकुन्तलोवाच

meaning.en: Shakuntala said:

verses.text:
यदि धर्मपथस्त्वेष यदि चात्मा प्रभुर्मम ।
प्रदाने पौरवश्रेष्ठ शृणु मे समयं प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: If this is the path of dharma, and if I have power to give myself, then hear my condition, best of the Pauravas.

verses.text:
सत्यं मे प्रतिजानीहि यत्त्वां वक्ष्याम्यहं रहः ।
मम जायेत यः पुत्रः स भवेत्त्वदनन्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Promise me truly what I tell you in private: the son born to me shall be your heir after you.

verses.text:
युवराजो महाराज सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीहि मे ।
यद्येतदेवं दुःषन्त अस्तु मे संगमस्त्वया ॥

meaning.en: Great king, say that this is true. If it is so, Dushyanta, let our union take place.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमस्त्विति तां राजा प्रत्युवाचाविचारयन् ।
अपि च त्वां नयिष्यामि नगरं स्वं शुचिस्मिते ।
यथा त्वमर्हा सुश्रोणि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: The king answered her without hesitation, 'So be it. I will also take you to my city, bright-smiling lady, as you deserve; I tell you this truly.'

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा स राजर्षिस्तामनिन्दितगामिनीम् ।
जग्राह विधिवत्पाणावुवास च तया सह ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the royal sage took the blameless lady's hand according to the rite and stayed with her.

verses.text:
विश्वास्य चैनां स प्रायादब्रवीच्च पुनः पुनः ।
प्रेषयिष्ये तवार्थाय वाहिनीं चतुरङ्गिणीम् ।
तया त्वामानयिष्यामि निवासं स्वं शुचिस्मिते ॥

meaning.en: After reassuring her he left, saying again and again, 'I will send a four-limbed army for you, and with it I will bring you to my home, bright-smiling one.'

verses.text:
इति तस्याः प्रतिश्रुत्य स नृपो जनमेजय ।
मनसा चिन्तयन्प्रायात्काश्यपं प्रति पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: Having promised her this, O Janamejaya, the king set off toward his city, pondering in his mind about Kashyapa (Kanva).

verses.text:
भगवांस्तपसा युक्तः श्रुत्वा किं नु करिष्यति ।
एवं संचिन्तयन्नेव प्रविवेश स्वकं पुरम् ॥

meaning.en: 'What will the venerable ascetic do when he hears of it?' Thinking thus, he entered his own city.

verses.text:
मुहूर्तयाते तस्मिंस्तु कण्वोऽप्याश्रममागमत् ।
शकुन्तला च पितरं ह्रिया नोपजगाम तम् ॥

meaning.en: When he had been gone but a moment, Kanva came back to the hermitage, but Shakuntala, out of shame, did not go up to her father.

verses.text:
विज्ञायाथ च तां कण्वो दिव्यज्ञानो महातपाः ।
उवाच भगवान्प्रीतः पश्यन्दिव्येन चक्षुषा ॥

meaning.en: Kanva, great in austerity and gifted with divine knowledge, understood and, pleased, spoke to her, seeing all with his divine sight.

verses.text:
त्वयाद्य राजान्वयया मामनादृत्य यत्कृतः ।
पुंसा सह समायोगो न स धर्मोपघातकः ॥

meaning.en: 'What you did today in secret, without waiting for me, by joining with a man, does not violate dharma.

verses.text:
क्षत्रियस्य हि गान्धर्वो विवाहः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते ।
सकामायाः सकामेन निर्मन्त्रो रहसि स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: For a Kshatriya the Gandharva marriage is called the best: a woman who desires and a man who desires, uniting in private without ritual formulas.

verses.text:
धर्मात्मा च महात्मा च दुःषन्तः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
अभ्यगच्छः पतिं यं त्वं भजमानं शकुन्तले ॥

meaning.en: Dushyanta is righteous and great-souled, the best of men. Shakuntala, you have gone to a husband who sought you.

verses.text:
महात्मा जनिता लोके पुत्रस्तव महाबलः ।
य इमां सागरापाङ्गां कृत्स्नां भोक्ष्यति मेदिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: A great-souled and mighty son will be born to you, who will enjoy this whole earth bounded by the ocean.

verses.text:
परं चाभिप्रयातस्य चक्रं तस्य महात्मनः ।
भविष्यत्यप्रतिहतं सततं चक्रवर्तिनः ॥

meaning.en: And when that great soul marches against enemies, his wheel of sovereignty, as a universal emperor, will roll on unobstructed.'

verses.text:
ततः प्रक्षाल्य पादौ सा विश्रान्तं मुनिमब्रवीत् ।
विनिधाय ततो भारं संनिधाय फलानि च ॥

meaning.en: Then Shakuntala washed the rested sage's feet, and putting down his load and setting the fruits nearby, she said to him:

verses.text:
मया पतिर्वृतो योऽसौ दुःषन्तः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
तस्मै ससचिवाय त्वं प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: 'I have chosen as my husband Dushyanta, the best of men. You should show favour to him and his ministers.'

verses.text: कण्व उवाच

meaning.en: Kanva said:

verses.text:
प्रसन्न एव तस्याहं त्वत्कृते वरवर्णिनि ।
गृहाण च वरं मत्तस्तत्कृते यदभीप्सितम् ॥

meaning.en: 'For your sake I am already pleased with him, fair lady. Take from me whatever boon you wish on his behalf.'

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो धर्मिष्ठतां वव्रे राज्याच्चास्खलनं तथा ।
शकुन्तला पौरवाणां दुःषन्तहितकाम्यया ॥

meaning.en: Then Shakuntala, wishing well for Dushyanta, chose as her boon that the Pauravas be righteous and never fall from their kingdom.
